query:
SELECT w.id,
               w.name,
               w.is_active,
               w.created_at,
               w.updated_at,
               COALESCE(SUM(
                   CASE m.kind
                       WHEN 'sale_payment' THEN m.amount
                       WHEN 'sale_refund'  THEN -m.amount
                       WHEN 'account_payment' THEN m.amount
                       WHEN 'account_payment_refund' THEN -m.amount
                       WHEN 'purchase_payment' THEN -m.amount
                       WHEN 'purchase_refund'  THEN m.amount
                       WHEN 'supplier_account_payment' THEN -m.amount
                       WHEN 'supplier_account_refund' THEN m.amount
                       WHEN 'adjustment_in' THEN m.amount
                       WHEN 'expense' THEN -m.amount
                       WHEN 'adjustment_out' THEN -m.amount
                       ELSE 0
                   END
               ), 0)::numeric(14, 2) AS "balance!: Decimal"
        FROM wallets w
        LEFT JOIN wallet_movements m ON m.wallet_id = w.id
        WHERE w.id = $1
        GROUP BY w.id, w.name, w.is_active, w.created_at, w.updated_at
